info.title: Dachser Universal API
info.description: Connect to DACHSER's REST/JSON logistics APIs for transport orders, shipment tracking, proofs of delivery, freight costs, labels, routing, SSCCs, warehouse delivery documents, delivery order statuses, incoming goods documents, and stock.

post.description: Creates shipping labels for a shipment in Dachser.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

format.description: Label format. Use P for PDF or Z for ZPL.

count.description: Number of labels to receive. Maximum 10.

fontFileName.description: Font file name for ZPL label format.

shipment.description: Shipment data to render labels for.

acceptLanguage.description: Optional language sent as the Accept-Language header.
